items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys after EXPECTED TO PLAY / QUESTIONABLE hamstring designation.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirm from Eagles inactives; ETR expected
items.implication: Start as RB1; volume secure with Wicks/Smith out
items.opportunity: Goal-line and snap share full if healthy

items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury that made him GTD/QUESTIONABLE; optimism confirmed pregame.
items.why: Schefter report of official active status; Rams optimistic Saturday
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1 especially with Adams out
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected; no pitch count indicated initially

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Week 7 after being QUESTIONABLE; high ankle sprain will cause him to miss a third straight game.
items.why: ETR weekend summary and official designation after limited practice
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded; Huntley or backup elevated for fantasy
items.opportunity: Backup QB streaming or Ravens pass-catchers volume bump possible

items.text: Breece Hall unlikely then officially INACTIVE vs Dolphins after GTD/QUESTIONABLE with quad; limited practice only.
items.why: Rapoport sources: early in return, not full participant; confirmed inactive lists
items.implication: Misses fourth straight; Braelon Allen locked RB1/2 vs weak Miami D
items.opportunity: Allen handcuff/start elevation; Hall return likely Week 8 if full practice

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins down to 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD only.
items.implication: Coleman is the lead back; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded
items.opportunity: Coleman waiver/start priority; reverse prior Dobbins beneficiaries

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain on severity; watching with Tracy.
items.implication: Potential limited role or absence next; Tracy/backup opportunity
items.opportunity: Handcuff or Giants RB committee shift

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle (turned on purposeful slide) almost certainly fine; would be tilting if serious from correct non-TD slide.
items.why: Levitan direct take on ETR watch list
items.implication: No major downgrade; monitor practice but startable

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; Eagles WR depth thinned for MNF.
items.implication: Elevated targets to Goedert, other WRs, or RBs in passing game
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert or remaining Eagles pass-catchers upgrade

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN and activated/expected to play after IR return.
items.implication: Packers RB1 returns; monitor snap share vs committee

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, low EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan data on touches vs efficiency
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy floor/ceiling via opportunity despite inefficiency
items.opportunity: Goal-line and receiving work locked; trade value solid
items.conflict: Efficiency poor may limit long-term if scheme changes

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; sell-high if possible after big game.
items.why: Berry Pregame/Happy Hour take on explosion
items.implication: Trade while value peaked; underlying role may not sustain
items.conflict: Usage may not match points long-term

items.text: Texans WR routes: Nico Collins 24 of 29 Stroud dropbacks lead; Tank Dell only 6 in first game back, Noel left early turf toe.
items.implication: Collins clear alpha; Dell limited re-acclimation
items.opportunity: Nico locked WR1; Dell stash but not immediate start

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely available soon; monitor Wednesday practice

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (near every dropback) in second game without Rashee Rice; has never topped 83 rec yards in 37 games.
items.implication: High volume but historical ceiling capped; monitor efficiency
items.opportunity: WR3/flex with Rice out; deep-threat role
